highlights: The scope leaves no ghost, catches a comparator's fast switching, keeps running after Autoset, and its readings hold their digits still and update three times as often.
Settings opens from anywhere with Ctrl+comma or the gear and puts you back where you were. Listening on: Speakers or Headphones; the ambience plays quieter.
On a big window the docked scope takes half the window and scrolling no longer turns its knobs; on a touchpad, pinch zooms and two fingers pan the Bench.
Simulations are exact at any time step, no longer ring where a diode cuts off a coil's current, and read rectifier ripple right.
Circuits started from rest always run, Copy for LTspice copies the same circuit, and the breadboard refuses a dead short.
Every analysis is checked against ngspice, an independent circuit simulator.
